description: 0xSero's one-Spark vLLM profile for GLM-5.3-Flash, from GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-1x-DGX-Spark at 6ff8595a (CHANGELOG 1.1.2): the public 0xSero/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-TR3-2.0bpw K2 checkpoint (EXL3 2.0 bpw, codebook mcg, about 111 GB; the GitHub repository description says 2.33 bpw while its scripts and docs pin 2.0 bpw), the model's own native MTP layer 45 as a depth-2 speculator (all 288 experts, unquantized; the draft view is derived at container start with upstream's tools/prepare_mtp_draft.py as symlinks plus a filtered index over the same checkpoint), B12X sparse-attention backend, packed fp8_ds_mla KV cache, CUDA graphs on target and draft, glm47 reasoning and tool parsers, image input, 262144-token context, one sequence. The image is upstream's public arm64 b12x-mtp-1xspark-v2 build (a pinned local-inference-lab vLLM fork), pinned by digest. Upstream claims, not measured here: 18.7 to 19.2 tok/s single-stream decode flat across the window with sampling on, about 570 tok/s prefill at 4k, 727449 KV tokens; this kit's docs list 2048 for max-num-batched-tokens while its scripts use 7168, which is what is packaged. Licences are informational: the repository declares MIT while GitHub reports no detected licence, and the weights repository card says MIT. The separate M288-12L mosaic path of upstream (SGLang, no MTP) is a different recipe. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: GPU memory utilization 0.93, 0xSero's MEM_FRACTION default at 6ff8595a (.env.example line 17; start.sh line 52 passes it as --gpu-memory-utilization). The earlier 0.85 came from the 2026-10-11 offline memory fit (#1176), not from a hardware run; 0.85 × 130,663,231,488 = 111.06e9 bytes is less than the 111.35e9 bytes of K2 weights, so it would leave no KV cache. The declared peak is the admission maximum, an estimate until the run measures it.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 K2 native-MTP vLLM single Spark (0xSero)
